title: Settings

account.title: Account
account.sign_out_message: You'll need to sign in again to use Multica on this device.

avatar.permission_message: Camera access is required to take a photo.

email_fixed: Email is set at sign-up and can't be changed here.

groups.comments_description: New comments on issues you're subscribed to.
groups.updates_description: Edits to title, description, labels, priority, or due date.
groups.system_description: Account changes, security alerts, product updates.

push.title: Push on this device
push.master_description: Notify me when I'm needed: assignments, blocked issues, mentions, pending approvals. Multica stays connected in the background for this and shows a quiet ongoing notification.
push.blocked_hint: Notifications are blocked in Android. You'll see new items when you open the app.
push.category_assignments_description: When someone assigns an issue to you. Not when you assign yourself or an issue is assigned to a squad.
push.server_group_muted: Inbox group “{{group}}” is off – no notification for it.
push.server_group_coupled: The inbox group “Assignments” is now on as well.
push.quiet_hint: Deliver silently during quiet hours (not suppressed).
push.connection_off_hint: Off – you'll see new items when you open the app.
push.battery_restricted: Restricted – Android may end the connection; items then only arrive when you open the app.
push.battery_body: To get notifications even after hours, Multica stays connected in the background. The app needs an exemption from battery optimisation for that.
push.card_body: For assignments, blocked issues, mentions and pending approvals. Multica stays connected in the background for this and shows a quiet ongoing notification.
push.line_assigned_unknown: An issue was assigned to you.
push.no_workspace_text: No workspace left for notifications. Check them in the app.

view.title: View
view.mention_sort_frequency_hint: People and agents you mention most come first
view.mention_sort_footer: Counted on this device when you send a mention. Not synced.

hidden_actors.intro: Only in this app and this workspace. Issues and comments stay visible.
hidden_actors.load_failed: Could not load people and agents.

title_filter.invalid: Invalid pattern: {{message}}. The filter is off.
title_filter.too_long: Pattern too long (max. 200 characters). The filter is off.
title_filter.too_complex: Pattern too complex (nested repetition). The filter is off.
title_filter.too_slow: Pattern too slow. The filter is off.
title_filter.mute_push_help: No push for issues whose title matches. They still appear in the Inbox. Hidden people and agents keep notifying.
title_filter.mute_push_unavailable: Available when the title filter is on and the pattern is valid.
title_filter.scope: Applies to My Issues (list and board), projects and chat suggestions. Search, Inbox, sub-issues and opened issues still show everything.
